summary: We will wait and see. I still wonder if Bloomberg will just buy the entire nomination on Super Tuesday. If no one comes out of NH and SC as a clear winner, or more shenanigans, voters who care only about victory will flock to Bloomberg.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: We will wait and see. I still wonder if Bloomberg will just buy the entire nomination on Super Tuesday. If no one comes out of NH and SC as a clear winner, or more shenanigans, voters who care only about victory will flock to Bloomberg.
